# Grabber

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

Unity's Grabber and Thrower on a hand: locks onto what it touches while the grip is held, throws on release.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `grip_threshold` | `float` | grip over which it grabs (0.5) |
| `touch` | `float` | m that counts as touching (0.02) |
| `velocity_multiplier` | `float` | on the throw velocity (1) |
| `angular_velocity_multiplier` | `float` | on the kept angular velocity (1) |
| `collision_delay` | `float` | s before the hand and what it let go collide again (0.1) |
| `grabbing` | `bool` | written: the grip is held |
| `grabbed` | `bool` | written: something is locked |
| `object` | `entt::entity` | written: the entity held; null with `grabbed`: the world or a body that is no entity |

## Notes

Written by Grab.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: Grab, PlayerSpawn. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Grab](../systems/Grab.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<RigidBody>` in preinit (disconnected in finish): the grips of a destroyed hand or object are taken off without a throw.
  - At each physics step: `CollideShape` of the hand's shape (max separation `touch`), `FixedConstraint` (priority 1000, 40 velocity / 8 position steps) added at the deepest contact; removed on release, teleport, finish.
  - On a throw: `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of the released body.
  - Sets and clears collision groups of grabbed bodies.
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
